header.description: Two-ship supercharger scenario for v1.22r0, RE-MEASURED UNDER THE v1.25r0 TWO-SPEED BLOWER SCHEDULE (schedule unchanged; all numbers below are v1.25r0 measurements): a Yak-3 (crit_lo_alt_m 1000 / gear2_frac 15/16 / crit_alt_m 3000, the roster's LOWEST) and a P-51 (crit_lo_alt_m 3000 / gear2_frac 14/16 / crit_alt_m 7500, the two-stage two-speed Merlin) fly the IDENTICAL 5-phase schedule from the same start (2700 m, TAS 140) so per-airframe blower data is what splits their thrust behavior. They can never interact (no fire phases -> no projectiles; opposite great-circle arcs, lon 0 psi 90 vs lon 90 psi 270). The v1.25r0 twist: the SAME sealed 3000 m sigma-LUT node is the Yak-3's HIGH (FS) gear full-throttle height AND the P-51's LOW (MS) gear full-throttle height, so the same climb makes BOTH ships' lapse comparisons flip in flight -- one in each term of the two-speed max(). Phase 0 (t=0) full-throttle 1 g level acceleration at 2700 m: the Yak-3 sits ABOVE its ~1655 m gear-shift altitude, so it runs in HIGH gear at the FLAT 15/16 rating (lapse = 0.9375 exactly -- the gear2_frac constant, dyadic), while the P-51 sits below its 3000 m MS-gear FTH at RATED power (lapse = 1, the min's clamped branch); by t=600 Yak ~146.3, P-51 ~145.8. Phase 1 (t=600) a g 1.5 pull rotates the nose up (gamma to ~10.4/10.5 deg); phase 2 (t=1100) coasts the earned climb at 1 g -- the Yak-3 crosses 3000 m UPWARD at t~2067 (its FS-gear min flips: lapse becomes 15/16 * sigma(alt)/sigma(3000) < 15/16, numerator INTERPOLATED between the 3000/3500 LUT nodes) and the P-51 crosses the SAME node at t~2070 (its MS-gear min flips: lapse = sigma(alt)/sigma(3000) < 1, still comfortably above its flat 14/16 FS rating, so the max() stays on the LOW gear -- no gear change). NEITHER ship's max() flips sides anywhere in the flight (the Yak-3 is HIGH-gear throughout, the P-51 LOW-gear throughout -- gear-shift coverage lives in GOLDEN-SK-YakLa-001 and GOLDEN-SK-Blower-001). Phase 3 (t=2400) a g 0.5 push-over levels off; phase 4 (t=2550) 1 g full-throttle level acceleration to the end. Final: Yak 137.4 m/s @ 3197 m (lapse ~0.9189), P-51 135.6 m/s @ 3194 m (lapse ~0.9804). No guns: hp/regions full, ammo untouched, kills 0, last_hit_by -1. Exercises: the two-speed lapse max() with each gear term flipping its min() in flight on a different ship, the FLAT dyadic gear2_frac rating as a sealed constant in the bytes, the exact-node sigma(crit)/sigma(crit_lo) denominators (1000/3000/7500 are sealed LUT nodes), and lapse-scaled thrust under level acceleration AND climb.
header.introduced: NEW golden for the supercharger critical altitude (seal v1.22r0): the first scenario in which an airframe crosses its OWN crit_alt_m in flight, pinning the thrust-lapse branch flip end-to-end in C++ <-> Python lockstep. See ADR-Step8-FlightModel-Supercharger-v1.22r0.
